name: Suno
description: Suno generates songs from text, with a free plan and Pro and Premier paid plans.
features: Song downloads per month on paid plans
strengths: Free plan with 50 credits per day
Commercial use rights on Pro and Premier
limitations: Free songs have no commercial rights
The terms of service may limit commercial use even on paid plans
Subscription credits do not carry over

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Yearly billing 'saves $24'; the annual per-month price was not stated

plans.name: Premier
plans.note: Yearly billing 'saves $72'; the annual per-month price was not stated

free.details: 50 credits per day, uploads up to 8 minutes, no monthly song downloads, shared queue with 4 concurrent generations, no stem separation.

pricing.regional: Taxes are calculated at checkout. Currency shown only as '$'.

reference.billing: price shown on the page; billing label not stated

verification.notes: Product active. Monthly view, USD: Free $0 (50 credits a day, no commercial rights); Pro $8/month (2,500 credits, 20 downloads); Premier $24/month (10,000 credits, 60 downloads). The page says billing yearly saves $24 and $72; the annual per-month price is not shown, so it is not recorded. Taxes calculated at checkout.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Describe a song and get a full track with vocals and production

capabilities.title: Create a complete song from a description
capabilities.text: Give a genre, mood, theme or your own lyrics and Suno builds a full track in under a minute; instrumentals are possible too.

capabilities.title: Remix a track
capabilities.text: Change a song's style, rewrite its lyrics, or rebuild it around your own recording.

capabilities.title: Split a song into stems
capabilities.text: Stem separation divides a song into vocal and instrument stems.

capabilities.title: Sing with your own voice
capabilities.text: Record a few seconds of your voice and it can sing what you write in any style.

featureCards.name: Suno Studio
featureCards.text: A browser-based digital audio workstation for arranging, editing and mixing songs, with multitrack editing and MIDI export.

featureCards.name: Custom models
featureCards.text: Train a model on your own recordings.

featureCards.name: Creation controls
featureCards.text: Voices, Inspo, exclusions, vocal gender, and weirdness and style sliders.

featureCards.name: Music library
featureCards.text: Browse songs by genre, mood and occasion.

featureCards.name: Song Editor and audio uploads
featureCards.text: Listed on the Pro plan, with uploads of up to 8 minutes.

audienceDetail.text: The site says it serves people making music for the first time.
Studio, stems and remix tools are aimed at people who work with audio.
Named as a key audience, for music to go with videos and podcasts.

scenarios.title: Write a song for fun
scenarios.text: Try a prompt such as chill lo-fi beat about rainy mornings and refine the result.

scenarios.title: Make music for content
scenarios.text: The site says Pro plan users can create royalty-free music for YouTube, podcasts or ads.

scenarios.title: Remake a track
scenarios.text: Remix a song into another style or rewrite its lyrics.

scenarios.title: Build a beat
scenarios.text: Create and arrange parts, then export MIDI from Studio.

gettingStarted.text: Join for free; the site says no credit card is required.
Include a genre, mood, theme or your own lyrics.
Then regenerate, extend or refine the result.
